In detail

What each one is, who it is for, and what it still needs.

01Special OlympicsProposedHealth

Healthy Athletes

A free screening becomes real follow-up care.

Measured by

Follow-up care completed, not just recommended.

The proposal

Proposed by
Special Olympics
What it does
Reminders, adherence and navigation, carried from the screening to the appointment after it.
Who it is for
Athletes who get a free screening at a Special Olympics event.
Where it would run
Wherever Healthy Athletes screenings already happen.

What it still needs

Funding
Underwrite one pilot, end to end.
Technology
A team to build the app.
Somewhere to run it
A Special Olympics programme, and the care it refers into.
Partner on this pilot

02Governor Jay InsleeProposedEnergy

Clean Data Centers

States negotiate the buildout instead of absorbing it.

Measured by

Those terms adopted by one state.

The proposal

Proposed by
Governor Jay Inslee
What it does
Four terms a state can put on the table: clean power, jobs, affordability, community benefit.
Who it is for
State governments, and the communities a data center lands in.
Where it would run
One state, at the point a data center is sited.

What it still needs

Funding
Underwrite one pilot, end to end.
Technology
A partner to build the playbook and the numbers under it.
Somewhere to run it
A state preparing to negotiate.
Partner on this pilot

03Butler UniversityProposedHealth

Infant Mortality

Risk found early, in the weeks that decide outcomes.

Measured by

Risk identified early enough to act on.

The proposal

Proposed by
Butler University
What it does
A model reading maternal health data for early risk, and an intervention that acts on what it finds.
Who it is for
Mothers on Medicaid in Indianapolis.
Where it would run
Indianapolis.

What it still needs

Funding
Underwrite one pilot, end to end.
Technology
A partner to build the model.
Somewhere to run it
A health system or health department in Indianapolis, alongside Butler.
Partner on this pilot

04Secretary Miguel CardonaProposedEducation

Career Pathways

Guidance that follows a student from school to work.

Measured by

More students land in a defined pathway.

The proposal

Proposed by
Secretary Miguel Cardona
What it does
Personalised guidance for the students who get the least of it, from school through to work.
Who it is for
Low-income students in public schools.
Where it would run
Public school districts.

What it still needs

Funding
Underwrite one pilot, end to end.
Technology
A partner to build the guidance.
Somewhere to run it
A district willing to run it with its own students.

The Lion Forum

Kennedy Compound, Hyannis Port

Scroll
01

The convening

Founders, investors, elected officials.

The people who build sit with the people who decide.

02

What it is

A closed room, and a reason for the Institute to be standing in it.

Format
By invitation only, convened at the Kennedy Compound in Hyannis Port.
The room
Founders and investors who build these technologies, alongside the elected officials who decide how they are used.
Why it matters
Those two groups settle what a technology becomes, and they are seldom in one room while there is still time to shape it.
03

The Institute’s role

The Institute is a lead sponsor of the Lion Forum.

Pilots find their partners in this room, and come back to it to report what happened.
